description: 50,000 augmented benchmark samples constructed from 419 unique source reports.

augmentation.paragraph_definition: one non-empty source CSV section field
augmentation.drop_operation: independent Bernoulli removal for each paragraph; retain at least one
augmentation.reverse_operation: reverse retained paragraph objects together with section labels

test_record_schema: (q, H, Y), with two distinct augmented training reports in H
query_policy: q is constructed only from independently defined domain/date/task metadata templates
reference_policy: Y is an unmodified held-out source report used only for final evaluation
